capacity_target_estimates.limits: Estimates exclude additional non-snapshot growth and cannot guarantee future archive size.

history.limits: Alert history does not establish exact temporary allocation for each event.

policy_findings: The write budget is max(configured128GiB,largest observed allocated completed,incremental or temporary archive), not the sum of archive sizes.
Capacity subtracts a full future archive budget from current statvfs free space, including during an active snapshot write.
This is the tested conservative full-next-write policy. It overstates bytes still needed to complete that same active archive.
A warning records reduced recovery margin for another full write. It does not prove capture stopped or current free space is below the400GiB capture reserve.
Agave retains the previous recovery archive until the new full archive succeeds and then purges old archives. Prospective purge bytes are not current free space.
recommendations: Keep reserve,recovery,startup and alert thresholds unchanged.
Measure complete full-snapshot cycles, minimum free space and prewrite baselines before claiming sustained capacity.
Add informational in-flight allocation and remaining-write estimates only after exact writer and archive attribution; do not credit unknown temporary files or expected purge.
Maintain enough steady free capacity for full overlap plus other growth under the current policy.
